title: {bill}: The bill’s consequences and six values
pilot_notice: Local pilot · not a published release
reading_intro: This review walks through the bill one decision at a time. First you judge whether the evidence supports a claim about what the bill would cause. After a claim you accept, you judge, one value at a time, whether that consequence gives a reason to support or oppose the bill.
gate_intro: Yes means only that the evidence supports this exact claim. It does not accept any later claim or value link.
gate_question: Does the evidence support this shared claim?
gate_no_guide: No means insufficient support, not proof that the claim is false.
set_aside_guide: Every route for this decision needs a claim you marked No, so it is set aside as not shown. You can still open it and read it.
finals_intro: Each value’s result comes only from your current Yes answers to value links for that value. You do not judge each value again here. When both directions have a Yes, compare them.
final_presence_question: Considering {value}, your accepted value links give a reason to SUPPORT it, a reason to OPPOSE it, both, or neither.
final_strength_question: Considering {value}, which direction has the stronger reason overall?
strength_guide: Compare the overall case for each direction for this value. Consider all of the consequences, including their size, timing and reach, not only the strongest one. Count a consequence once, even if it appears in more than one place. Good evidence for an effect does not mean that the effect is large. Do not count points; there is no formula for a winner.
incomplete: Decisions for this value still required
stale_guide: You changed an earlier answer that this one depends on. This answer is kept but does not count until you look at it again and answer.
complete: All required decisions and comparisons are current.
public_final_guide: This page saves nothing. Sign in with Google to record answers to your reviewer account.
local_only: Your review is saved to your reviewer account. Each change is kept first in this browser and then sent to the server; it counts as saved only when the server confirms it. To keep a separate copy, export a JSON backup.
sessions_label: Your sessions for this bill, release and session type
memory_only: Not saved in this browser. Your current review remains in memory; export a JSON backup now and keep this tab open.
storage_failure: This browser could not save your review. Export a JSON backup now and keep this tab open. Check that browser storage is allowed before returning.
read_only: This session is open for writing in another tab. This tab is read-only. Close the other tab, then reload this one to continue. You can still export this copy.
conflict: The saved data for this session changed in another tab or window. This tab will not overwrite it. Export this copy, then reload to open the saved version.
lock_unavailable: This browser cannot reserve a single writing tab. Review is read-only here. Open this pilot in a browser that supports Web Locks to record judgments.
import_json: Import JSON backup as a new session
import_success: Backup imported as a new session. The original session is unchanged.
import_error: This backup could not be imported. Use an unedited JSON backup from this exact pilot release. Your current session is unchanged.
input_error: This answer could not be saved. Choose Yes or No. For a comparison, choose the stronger direction.
load_error: A saved session could not be opened. Its saved data have been preserved. Export any current in-memory review before starting another session.
download_error: The export could not be downloaded. Keep this tab open and try exporting again.
event_import: Backup opened as a new session
originals_intro: These are the full original arguments, responses and shared claims this review was built from. Reading them is optional, and they need no answers.
originals_search: Search original text, source records and notes
scope_label: What this claim covers and its limits
strength_evidence_label: Evidence about size, timing and reach
earlier_notice: This is the earlier wording, kept for the record. It may include wording that was later corrected.
no_results: No source records match this search.
discard_drafts: You have unsaved changes in an answer. Discard them and switch sessions? Your saved answers stay saved.
tree_intro: Answer one decision at a time. A Yes accepts only the claim or value link shown. A No means insufficient support, not proof that the claim is false. A No sets aside the later decisions that need that claim; other routes stay open. Leaving a decision blank is not a No.
public_tree_intro: Read each decision and its evidence. Sign in with Google to record answers to your reviewer account.
value_link_question: Considering {value}, does this consequence give a reason to {direction} {bill}?
value_link_guide: A Yes accepts only this link between the consequence and this value. No means the support for this reason is insufficient. It is not a reason in the other direction.
trail_intro: Each answer is used wherever the bill’s reasoning needs it. Reopening an answer keeps later answers and marks them for another look when their basis changes.
decision_pruned: Set aside by an earlier No
pruned_reason: This decision needs an earlier claim you marked No, so it is set aside as not shown.
unresolved_reason: Resolve the earlier required steps before answering this one.
reassessment_reason: The basis for this answer changed. Look at it again before it counts.
no_more_decisions: All required claim and value-link decisions are answered or set aside.
derived_results_intro: Each value’s result comes only from your current Yes answers to value links for that value. Both requires your overall comparison. No count of links decides the result.
derived_results_partial: Some required decisions remain. These results are provisional.
comparison_required: Compare the accepted SUPPORT and OPPOSE reasons for this value.
causal_question: Does the evidence support this claim?
carry_notice: Your saved answers from an earlier version of this review were carried into this corrected version as a new session. Decisions whose content changed, and answers that rest on them, are marked for another look and do not count until you answer them again. The earlier session is kept unchanged.
coordinator_export: Export every reviewer’s sessions for this bill (CSV)
coordinator_error: The reviewers’ sessions could not be exported. Nothing was changed.
